human_notes: All conveyor rows come from the RUN tar.gz (FORTNA/Conveyor.asc). TYPE is inferred from ASC Type (STRAIGHT/CURVE/ACCUM/…) + whether a VFD drive is linked. AREA defaults to {controller}_Area from RUN (not Zone1–Zone9 from P-digit). Zone1_Area..Zone9_Area remain dropdown suggestions only — they do not auto-create Safety zones. Exit PE is the product/discharge PE tag linked to that conveyor in the ASC (or PE list). Dropdowns let you override; Generate uses your choices.

automation.type_rules: ASC Type ACCUM/ZEROPRESSURE → Accumulation with MS/VFD; STRAIGHT/CURVE/MERGE/… → Transport with MS/VFD; VFD vs MS chosen when Drive/VFD tags exist for that conveyor
automation.area_rules: RUN seed uses {controller}_Area; Zone1_Area..Zone9_Area are UI suggestions only and do not auto-promote Safety zones (Gate R)
automation.exit_pe_rules: Product/exit PE tags from Conveyor.asc PE columns for that conveyor
needs_human: Area rename / merge (Redroom vs Zone5 style)
TYPE override when ASC type is wrong
Special PE jam/full options if non-standard
